Creative case study

Automotive

A cinematic driving moment, shaped into a focused automotive ad concept.

CategoryAutomotive
PlatformsFacebook & Instagram
FormatMotion & aspiration
TypeCreative concept

The brief

Beautiful footage can attract attention without creating a qualified enquiry. An automotive ad needs to connect the feeling of the drive to a specific vehicle, service, or appointment.

The creative
direction.

Lead with the red sports car in motion, then introduce a single proposition: discover the vehicle or book a service. End with the next step and the information a buyer needs. Separate awareness creative from enquiry-focused variations.

01 / Opening hook

Make the next drive count.

An example opening line to test with this footage.

02 / Next step

Enquire about your next drive

One action, aligned with the offer and the destination.

03 / Measurement

Track what matters.

Qualified enquiries, appointment requests, and cost per qualified lead.

This is a creative concept using licensed stock footage already featured on our site. Performance is measured after a campaign launches; no client results are claimed here.
